# think-to-recall (ctxgraph)

> A local decision memory for AI coding assistants: a Claude Code MCP server and CLI that remembers what you decided, refused and postponed in earlier chats, with dates and reports, and gives it back to a new chat. No cloud, no LLM calls.

## Docs

- [INSTALL_FOR_AI.md](INSTALL_FOR_AI.md): step-by-step install for an AI assistant (ask the user, then `ctxgraph setup` with flags)
- [README.md](README.md): what it does, install, tools, how recall works, privacy, limits
- [README.ru.md](README.ru.md): the same in Russian

## MCP tools

- overview(): call FIRST in a new chat - the project map in <= ~600 tokens without reading code: Graphify code communities (main files, functions, links) ranked by entry points, PageRank and recent commits, with the newest decisions that name their code or whose commit touched it; tests/scripts/docs, git-ignored paths and overview.exclude patterns (gitignore-style, project root) are left out; without a code graph, conversation topics with their newest decisions and a hint to run `ctxgraph setup --graphify yes`
- recall(question, steps, k, detail, fresh): earlier turns relevant to the question and reasoning steps; detail full / brief / mixed; one line when nothing is about the question; in brief, records already shown in the session are one line "#id (shown earlier): date · gist" (reset after compaction and in a new session; fresh=True repeats them)
- expand(record_id): one record in full plus its thread by date
- decisions(limit): decision chronology with confirmations and reports
- later(limit): open "later" items (on hold, answered "later", deferred Beads issues read from .beads/*.jsonl)
- rules, pin_rule(text), unpin_rule(id): permanent project rules (the user's always / never / from now on)
- remember(text, role): save one statement explicitly
- save_chat(title, turns, offset): save THIS chat on the user's request ("add this chat to memory"): turns verbatim with roles, <= 30 per call, oldest first; repeat-safe (only new turns are added)
- import_claude_ai(export, match, project_name, since): claude.ai data export; without a filter it lists the conversations and imports nothing
- import_history: import earlier Claude Code sessions (on request)
- forget(episode): hide a turn from recall
- memory_status, show_graph: what is stored; the graph view path

## Claude Desktop

- Extension: ctxgraph-<version>.mcpb on the GitHub release (one click, asks for the project folder; runs ~/.local/bin/ctxgraph-mcp from a uv/pipx install). No remote connector URL: the memory is local.

## Setup flags

- Before `ctxgraph setup`, ask the user in ONE chat message (defaults in brackets): import the history of earlier conversations about this project? (no) -> --import-history yes|no; will you work with code here? (no) - if yes: also install Graphify so the memory sees the code structure? (no) -> --graphify yes|no, if no: --graphify no; labels in Russian or English? (the conversation's language; skip when obvious) -> --lang ru|en. No answer: no / no / the conversation's language. See INSTALL_FOR_AI.md
- --import-history yes|no, --graphify yes|no, --wordnet yes|no, --lang ru|en: answers without a terminal; -y takes the defaults
- --quality: BM25 + multilingual-e5-base (int8 ONNX, ~300 MB)
- --lang en|ru (global): language of the labels
